Keep readme.md and page.js as the record; delete the CSS.

Same proof as new-1-site-styles: zero importers, unreachable route. 29 sheets under new/1/site/** sum to 1630 lines (wc over `find core/new -name '*.css'` = 1851 minus styles.css 221). Also 38 css( call-sites in new/1/**/page.js demo pages are dead with them (JS lines not counted here).

proposal: Delete the whole core/new sandbox stylesheet set first: 1,851 lines, zero importers, and no route reaches it, which is 41% of everything audited here for the price of one grep. Next, build three small shared pieces once: a nav-row (one clickable row with an icon, a hover fill and an active mark, written four times today), a layout-sketch (the miniature that draws a layout as boxes, written twice), and a column-looks word set (three mechanisms for column backgrounds). Then swap hand-written flex shells, tables, padding and shrunk buttons for words framework.css already has: .flex.v.gap, .pad, .size-small, the base table rules, and the --paper-aNN rungs that Sidebar re-mixes with color-mix. The rest (the page shell, columns system, rail, wall, stage and preview card) is genuinely core's own vocabulary and should be KEPT, not shrunk. Note that core/Search (185 lines) and core/App/mode.css (21) sit in core but outside this audit's named dirs.
risk: low for the core/new delete (zero importers); medium for the Frame/word-class swaps because Page.class.js and Frame.js stamp the class names; several generator.css clusters were read only by selector list and are marked unverified.
